name: mcp-language-server
description: mcp-language-server (isaacphi, BSD-3-Clause) — real diagnostics/rename/definition via a backing LSP (gopls/rust-analyzer/pyright…). Offline (net:false). Spawns ONLY the user-named LSP ($MCP_LSP_COMMAND), no arbitrary shell. Runtime deps: the Go binary + the chosen LSP (or set MCP_LANGUAGE_SERVER_BIN).
